metadata.name: Ghost
metadata.summary: Ghost 6 for blogs and newsletters, with MySQL and your own SMTP server.

zh-CN.summary: Ghost 的工作负载在自己的命名空间里运行，镜像以 digest 固定版本，以非 root 身份运行，根文件系统只读，没有 API 令牌，多余的权限也都去掉了。对外连接没有限制。

zh-TW.summary: Ghost 的工作負載在自己的命名空間裡執行，映像檔以 digest 固定版本，以非 root 身分執行，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有 API 權杖，多餘的權限也都拿掉了。對外連線沒有限制。

zh-CN.mitigation: Ghost 一能响应，ghost-setup Job 就会用 ownerEmail 和 ghost-secrets/admin-password 里生成的密码创建所有者。它每两秒检查一次，所以空窗期很短。任何能访问该域名的人都能打开 /ghost 和它的 API，Ghost 本身有登录机制。想限制谁能访问 /ghost，请在服务的网络设置里添加 IP 限制。
zh-CN.risk: 如果 Ghost 还没完成初始化，第一个来的访客就能创建网站所有者。

zh-TW.mitigation: Ghost 一能回應，ghost-setup Job 就會用 ownerEmail 和 ghost-secrets/admin-password 裡產生的密碼建立擁有者。它每兩秒檢查一次，所以空窗期很短。任何連得到網域的人都能打開 /ghost 和它的 API，Ghost 本身有登入機制。想限制誰能連到 /ghost，請在服務的網路設定裡加上 IP 限制。
zh-TW.risk: 如果 Ghost 還沒完成初始化，第一個來的訪客就能建立網站擁有者。

risks.mitigation: As soon as Ghost answers, the ghost-setup Job creates the owner from ownerEmail and the generated password in ghost-secrets/admin-password. It checks every two seconds, so the window before it runs is short. /ghost and its APIs are open to anyone who can reach the domain, and Ghost has its own sign-in. To limit who can reach /ghost, add an IP limit in the service's network settings.
risks.risk: If Ghost has not been set up yet, the first visitor can create the site owner.

zh-CN.mitigation: 只保留一个副本。MySQL 备份和内容备份都要存放在节点之外，并妥善保护。在承诺高可用或自动恢复到任意时间点之前，请先从目录添加 MySQL operator。
zh-CN.risk: MySQL 是以普通的 StatefulSet 运行，没有 operator 在管理。

zh-TW.mitigation: 只保留一個副本。MySQL 備份和內容備份都要存在節點以外的地方，並妥善保護。在承諾高可用或自動還原到任意時間點之前，請先從目錄加入 MySQL operator。
zh-TW.risk: MySQL 是以單純的 StatefulSet 執行，沒有 operator 在管理。

risks.mitigation: Keep one replica. Store both the MySQL backups and the content backups off the node, and protect them. Add a MySQL operator from the catalog before you promise high availability or automatic point-in-time recovery.
risks.risk: MySQL runs as a plain StatefulSet, with no operator to manage it.

zh-CN.mitigation: 提供现成的 SMTP 机密。大量发送电子报时，在 Ghost 里设置 Mailgun。备份里的服务商凭证要妥善保护。模板不含自托管的 ActivityPub 和 Tinybird 分析。
zh-CN.risk: Ghost 发送事务邮件和电子报，要依赖外部服务。

zh-TW.mitigation: 提供現成的 SMTP 機密。大量寄送電子報時，在 Ghost 裡設定 Mailgun。備份裡的服務商認證資訊要妥善保護。範本不含自架的 ActivityPub 和 Tinybird 分析。
zh-TW.risk: Ghost 寄交易通知信和電子報，要靠外部服務。

risks.mitigation: Provide an existing SMTP Secret. Set up Mailgun in Ghost for bulk newsletters. Protect the provider credentials in your backups. Self-hosted ActivityPub and Tinybird analytics are not included.
risks.risk: Ghost depends on outside services to send transactional email and newsletters.

security.summary: Ghost's workloads run in their own namespace, pinned by image digest, as non-root with a read-only root filesystem, no API token and extra capabilities dropped. Outbound traffic is not limited.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ghost-data
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ghost-mysql-data
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: ghost-mysql
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ghost-mysql
  ports:
  - name: mysql
    port: 3306
    targetPort: mysql
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: ghost
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  serviceName: ghost
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: ghost
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: ghost
        app.kubernetes.io/name: ghost
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: ghost
        image: ghost:6-alpine@sha256:4195f6c405e40230cd10c0770425cf500c1f542a96e9f6584c11649c150e5a89
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 2368
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '2'
            memory: 1Gi
        env:
        - name: url
          value: https://{{ .Domain }}
        - name: database__client
          value: mysql
        - name: database__connection__host
          value: ghost-mysql
        - name: database__connection__database
          value: ghost
        - name: database__connection__user
          value: ghost
        - name: database__connection__port
          value: '3306'
        - name: database__connection__password
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: ghost-secrets
              key: database-password
        - name: mail__transport
          value: SMTP
        - name: mail__from
          value: '{{ .Inputs.smtpFrom }}'
        - name: mail__options__host
          value: '{{ .Inputs.smtpHost }}'
        - name: mail__options__port
          value: '{{ .Inputs.smtpPort }}'
        - name: mail__options__secure
          value: '{{ .Inputs.smtpSecure }}'
        - name: mail__options__requireTLS
          value: 'true'
        - name: mail__options__auth__user
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: '{{ .Inputs.smtpSecret }}'
              key: username
        - name: mail__options__auth__pass
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: '{{ .Inputs.smtpSecret }}'
              key: password
        - name: logging__transports
          value: '["stdout"]'
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /var/lib/ghost/content
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        startupProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: http
          failureThreshold: 120
          periodSeconds: 5
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /ghost/api/admin/site/
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
        livenessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: ghost-data
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 512Mi
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: ghost-setup
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  backoffLimit: 6
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: ghost
        app.kubernetes.io/name: ghost-setup
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: setup
        image: ghost:6-alpine@sha256:4195f6c405e40230cd10c0770425cf500c1f542a96e9f6584c11649c150e5a89
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 10m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 128Mi
        env:
        - name: DOMAIN
          value: '{{ .Domain }}'
        - name: OWNER_EMAIL
          value: '{{ .Inputs.ownerEmail }}'
        - name: OWNER_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: ghost-secrets
              key: admin-password
        command:
        - node
        - -e
        - |
          const http = require('http');
          const call = (method, body) => new Promise((ok, fail) => {
            const r = http.request({host: 'ghost', port: 2368, path: '/ghost/api/admin/authentication/setup/', method,
              headers: {Host: process.env.DOMAIN, 'X-Forwarded-Proto': 'https', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}},
              (res) => { let d = ''; res.on('data', (c) => d += c); res.on('end', () => ok({status: res.statusCode, body: d})); });
            r.on('error', fail);
            r.end(body);
          });
          (async () => {
            for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
              try {
                const g = await call('GET');
                if (g.status === 200) {
                  if (JSON.parse(g.body).setup[0].status) return;
                  const p = await call('POST', JSON.stringify({setup: [{name: 'Owner', email: process.env.OWNER_EMAIL,
                    password: process.env.OWNER_PASSWORD, blogTitle: process.env.DOMAIN}]}));
                  if (p.status === 200 || p.status === 201) return;
                  console.error('setup answered', p.status);
                }
              } catch (e) {}
              await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000));
            }
            process.exit(1);
          })();
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: ghost
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ghost
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 2368
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: ghost
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - '{{ .Domain }}'
    secretName: ghost-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: ghost
            port:
              number: 2368
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: ghost-mysql
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  serviceName: ghost-mysql
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: ghost-mysql
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: ghost
        app.kubernetes.io/name: ghost-mysql
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 999
        runAsGroup: 999
        fsGroup: 999
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: ghost-mysql
        image: mysql:8.4@sha256:a81d043930e51745522bd5c430961cf8286f0a23f0a9a2a6e0108f7ea71b0902
        ports:
        - name: mysql
          containerPort: 3306
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '2'
            memory: 1Gi
        env:
        - name: MYSQL_DATABASE
          value: ghost
        - name: MYSQL_USER
          value: ghost
        - name: MYSQL_ROOT_HOST
          value: localhost
        - name: MYSQL_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: ghost-secrets
              key: database-password
        - name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: ghost-secrets
              key: root-password
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /var/lib/mysql
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        - name: run
          mountPath: /var/run/mysqld
        args:
        - --socket=/var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock
        - --pid-file=/var/run/mysqld/mysqld.pid
        - --skip-name-resolve
        - --host-cache-size=0
        - --max-allowed-packet=10M
        - --performance-schema=OFF
        startupProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: mysql
          failureThreshold: 90
          periodSeconds: 5
        readinessProbe:
          exec:
            command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -ec
            - MYSQL_PWD="$MYSQL_PASSWORD" mysql --protocol=TCP -h127.0.0.1 -ughost -Dghost -e "SELECT 1"
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
        livenessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: mysql
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: ghost-mysql-data
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 512Mi
      - name: run
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 32Mi
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
